English Language Requirements
Recognised English Language Qualifications
English language requirementsRecognised English Language Qualifications for Pre-sessional and Degree Entry
All English qualifications must be dated within two years of the start date of the course.
For entry onto Online / Off Campus Pre-sessional English
Online Pre-sessional English is taught fully online with students remaining in their home countries. Therefore, a wider range of English language qualifications may be accepted for entry to Online Pre-sessional English, including:
IELTS Academic (UKVI SELT or non-UKVI)
IELTS Academic Online
IELTS Academic One Skill Re-take (UKVI SELT or non-UKVI)
Pearson Test of English (PTE) Academic (UKVI)
As of 1st February, 2025, Pearson Test of English (PTE) Academic (non-UKVI) will no longer be accepted. Applicants are advised to provide an alternative test from the list of approved qualifications in order to meet English requirements. Applicants who have already booked or taken a PTE Academic (non-UKVI) test between 13th January and 31st January, 2025, should contact the University on the Applicant Portal for further advice.
Trinity College London Integrated Skills in English (ISE) II
LanguageCert Academic (SELT)
Skills for English SELT B2
Skills for English SELT B1
TOEFL IBT
Cambridge First Certificate of English (FCE)
Cambridge Certificate of Advanced English (CAE)
Oxford International Digital Institute English Language Level Test (OI Digital Institute ELLT): If you plan to take this test, please contact oxford-int-ellt@strath.ac.uk before application, to receive a discount code.
Oxford International Digital Institute English Language Level Test (OI Digital Institute ELLT) Global
Oxford International Digital Institute English Language Level Test (OI Digital Institute ELLT) Skill Retake
Oxford Test of English
Kaplan International Tools for English (KITE) (Kaplan Test of English from 15th March, 2024): If you plan to take this test, please contact kte@strath.ac.uk before application, to receive a discount code.
Duolingo English Test
Please refer to the ELT webpage for guidance on the length of Pre-sessional course, or contact ELT directly: elt@strath.ac.uk
For entry onto On Campus Pre-sessional English
On Campus Pre-sessional English is taught fully on campus. Applicants will require a Secure English Language Test (SELT) to obtain a Study Visa for the UK, including:
IELTS Academic (UKVI SELT)
IELTS Academic One Skill Re-take (with an IELTS UKVI SELT)
Pearson Test of English (PTE) Academic (UKVI)
Trinity College London Integrated Skills in English (ISE) II
LanguageCert Academic (SELT)
Skills for English SELT B2
Skills for English SELT B1
Applicants at CEFR B2 level, who also meet Pre-sessional entry requirements, can use one of the equivalent qualifications with CEFR B2 scores listed below instead of a SELT and be eligible for a single CAS (CAS to cover Pre-sessional English and main degree programme):
IELTS Academic (non-UKVI): 5.5 overall, with a minimum of 5.5 in each component.
IELTS Academic Online: 5.5 overall, with a minimum of 5.5 in each component.
IELTS Academic One Skill Re-take (UKVI SELT or non-UKVI): 5.5 overall, with a minimum of 5.5 in each component, after the One Skill Re-take.
TOEFL IBT: Tests dated up to and including 20th January, 2026: 72 overall, with the following minimum scores in each component: Listening: 17 Reading: 18 Speaking: 20 Writing: 17. Tests dated from 21st January, 2026: 4.0 overall, with a minimum of 4.0 in each component.
Cambridge First Certificate of English (FCE): 162 overall, with a minimum of 162 in each component.
Cambridge Certificate of Advanced English (CAE): 162 overall, with a minimum of 162 in each component.
Oxford International Digital Institute English Language Level Test (OI Digital Institute ELLT):Tests dated up to and including 15th June, 2022: 4 overall, with a minimum of 4 in each component. Tests dated from 16th June, 2022: 5 overall, with a minimum of 5 in each component. If you plan to take this test, please contact oxford-int-ellt@strath.ac.uk before application, to receive a discount code.
Oxford International Digital Institute English Language Level Test (OI Digital Institute ELLT) Global: 5 overall, with a minimum of 5 in each component.
Oxford International Digital Institute English Language Level Test (OI Digital Institute ELLT) Skill Retake: 5 overall, with a minimum of 5 in each component.
Oxford Test of English: 111 overall, with a minimum of 111 in each component.
Kaplan International Tools for English (KITE) (Kaplan Test of English from 15th March, 2024): KITE Main Flight / Overall Ability 396, with the following minimum scores in each component: Listening and Reading 396; Speaking and Writing 425. If you plan to take this test, please contact kte@strath.ac.uk before application, to receive a discount code.
Duolingo English Test: Tests dated up to and including 30th June, 2024: 100 overall, with a minimum of 100 in each Integrated subscore component (Literacy, Comprehension, Conversation and Production). Tests dated from 1st July, 2024: 100 overall, with a minimum of 105 in Reading, Speaking and Writing, and a minimum of 100 in Listening.
For all applicants, please refer to the ELT webpage for guidance on the length of Pre-sessional course, or contact ELT directly: elt@strath.ac.uk

Special measures in place for entry to 2025/26 academic year
As of 11th August, 2023, the Pearson Test of English (PTE) Academic Online will no longer be accepted. Applicants will instead be required to provide an alternative test from the list of approved qualifications in order to meet English requirements.
As of 21st March, 2024, LanguageCert International ESOL SELT B1 and B2 are no longer accepted, though tests taken on or before 21st March, 2024, may still be considered.
As of 1st February, 2025, Pearson Test of English (PTE) Academic (non-UKVI) will no longer be accepted. Applicants are advised to provide an alternative test from the list of approved qualifications in order to meet English requirements. Applicants who have already booked or taken a PTE Academic (non-UKVI) test between 13th January and 31st January, 2025, should contact the University on the Applicant Portal for further advice.
From 13th January, 2025, the Duolingo English Test will be accepted from applicants from all nationalities.
Also from 13th January, 2025, the Duolingo English Test component score entry requirements for tests dated from 1st July, 2024, will be based on the Individual subscores of Speaking, Writing, Listening and Reading (SWRL), and not the Integrated subscores of Literacy, Comprehension, Conversation and Production (LCCP). For tests dated up to and including 30th June, 2024, the component entry score requirements will be based on the Integrated subscores of Literacy, Comprehension, Conversation and Production (LCCP).
IELTS Indicator and TOEFL (ibt) Home Edition will not be accepted for Pre-sessional entry for academic year 2024/25 or for main degree entry in academic year 2025/26.
